content: Ina-nara ama-hyali, mak Uplerlawna Nkamieh niana miy yoma mlia' temn olek la'a riy maka Uplerlawna Npol niana pa mlier la Ilyamou-Watyatoha, a'ukota pa mpiaror nohor teka Yesus dina! Yoma E' ed makodi Uplerlawna lirni-tunnu mai ita, me la' walia Nhi' makpolu-makwak la Uplerlawna la it rerieini (imam). E' ed maka itpesiaya.

Yesus di, e Ndenrer lia (setia) Uplerlawna mak ktutmuata-kewra' E'a, pa emekwalima Musa la ululu de nawe'ena-namtemna la Uplerlawna mutnu-rahanu honona pa emeknekama riy ida nawe'ena-namtemna la kniarni la upni-matromni romni.
Mere Yesus di ed maka klernana nhiu'ru-nhielma, yatota-yawawa de narehia Musa emeknekama riy maka kariria roma ed maka klernana ya'uli-yawedi nhiu'ru-nhielma, de narehia rom maka ha narir die.
Roma re honona, rimormiori er mak karia re, mere mak khi'a haneknek wawannu de Uplerlawna orgahani Nmeh'a.

Musa nawe'ena-namtemna pa nhima-nre'a Uplerlawna mutnu-rahanu, mere e genni-tienni de emekto'ama hopopna-lili'ir id neka mak khima-kre'a la matromni romni. Ne Musa hihi'ini-yapyapni de ntut muemna hya' mak hota Uplerlawna Nalharia la'a tuw li'iru.

Mere Yesus Kristus Narehia Musa, yoma Endenrer lia Uplerlawna pa emekneka a'na id mak kodi plolli la amni romni. Ne hota it di de er mak ha riwra Uplerlawna romni mniotni it irhatti, hornama yana itamta'at pa twalera mere itsa'ar rer mia't it ralamni la hya' maka hota Uplerlawna Nala mai ita. Hade ed mak khi' it pa tahepuepur nohora.
Yana o'ta tehra emeka makden Yahudi la'a wo'orletna-kawurloini
Pede ina-nara ama-hyali, mliernohora hya' ed maka Uplerlawna Nhiw Lululli Nakota, Niwra:

content.text: “La'pa la'a lera-mela ri, de miy e mitlin nana Uplerlawna lirni de
yan memmemna miy o'ta tehra pa emekneka upmi-tgarmi, la' ler maka rta'aga Uplerlawna, yoma rmalawan pa rtut o'ta kpaunu la E'a la wo'orletna-kawurloini.

La'a wo'orletna-kawurloini de, miy upmi-tgarmi ramkek nana A hihi'u-yapya'pu mak kamehi-kayona la anni terampwogat memna, mere emkade ho'mana rta'aga me rtot ma't A'u yoma rhi' ma'ta o'ta tehrani-ratlinnon keran mai A'u!
La' hade pede A'uwenan la ira pa A'ukota giwra ir ralamni rod rer mia'ta la dodo'a-halala pede irakleh oleka tlina-tail la'a A li'ru-tu'nu.
A'uwenan pa Aliokra re giwra: “Oi! Hota miy edonna mliernana gen miaka A'ukot targ oleka la riy makpesiay totpa hota ror A' pua mren ami la geni kalwie'du.””

content: Pede ina-nara ama-hyali, mpiahniorta. Mitiak reria totpena yana riy dom la' miy wokmi-le'emi ihranu-ralamni re rod rer ir la do'a-hala pede rakleha pesiay nareiniande rawlar dioinia Uplerlawna, de la'a Orgahi-Orha'a, mak kden pa nodi liarni!

Mere hota lera-mela ri, de la' ler maka ha riwra “Lera yamori-yalewna inhatti,” hota miy idma nhedu-ntehra reri ida totpena pesiaymi la'a ga'a. Totpena hota la' hade pede riy id tiy miy miana edonna mliernohora lir wokmaru mak kodi miy lia do'a-hala pa mtiutga o'ta tehra-tlinnona kpau lia Uplerlawna.
Yoma it di de tlernan hare honona maka Yesus Kristus Nhi' nan de, hornama itatorrer pitpitga ita pesiayni maka itlernan oleka la mulaliaini de la'pa ntutu-nte'ela hohoni.
Ina-nara, mhioratreria hya' ed maka ha rakot targa la Puka ralamni, Niwra:

content.text: “La'pa mitlin nana Uplerlawna lirni la' lera-mela ri, de yana mhi' tehra ralamni pa mtiolliohora upmi-tgarmi, maka la' ler ululu rhi' tlinnon keranni-o'ta kpaunu lia Uplerlawna.”

content: He' ed mak katlina Uplerlawna lirni, mere ratlinnon kerna-o'ta kpau? De ir honona re, de riy maka Musa ha nalewna pa nodgiot ir la Mesir irhatti toh!
Ne riy meni er maka Uplerlawna Nawenan la anni terampwogata deno? Enawenan la'a maka Musa nodia re mere rhi' do'a-hala, pede Nukum wenwenna ir la wo'orletna-kawurloini!

La' ler de Uplerlawna liokarni de emkadi: “Oi! Hota miy di edonna mliernan gen miaka A'ukot targ oleka la makpesiay, totpa hota ror A' pua mtu'u-mren am lia gen die!” Ne hota he' ed mak Uplerlawna lirni ha ntai lia dino? Maka Uplerlawna lirni ha ntaiya de, la' riy maka katlinnon kerna-ka'o'ta kpau lia Uplerlawna.
Pede ina-nara ama-hyali mpiahniorta! Yoma itat niohora memna, ir de edonna rlernan gen die, yoma ir rakleha pesiay lia Uplerlawna.
